title: Voice Lint and Voice Studio: readiness
summary: Canonical product source is agent-orc/voice-lint. A fresh GitHub clone at 33063b5 passed dependency installation, both library builds, Angular, .NET, website build and strict artifact verification. Devspace retirement commit 53188ed removes only the 299 old Voice files and adds a canonical repository pointer; history and unrelated tree entries are preserved. Six product pages received contextual EN/DE copy review alongside explicitly limited lexical checks. Catalogue 0.2.2 clarifies evidence for evaluative modifiers; 33 library tests pass. Full German translations and 48 static language URLs are prepared with canonical/hreflang and source-hash/code-parity checks. Local browser, SEO, research, writing-pattern and original-source onboarding checks pass; public verification of the new release is in progress; no measured model-quality winner or general production readiness is established. Studio remains a supervised local preview.
